Vertex WebView

no JavaScript needed

An HTML and CSS engine in pure Vertex

Parsed by text/html, styled by text/css, laid out and painted by ui/webview into a plain pixel buffer that ui/window presents.

Cascade

Specificity, !important, inheritance, em and rem, media queries, :hover and :focus.

style

Layout

Block flow with collapsing margins, inline formatting with real line breaking, flexbox, and positioned boxes.

layout

Paint

Anti-aliased rounded corners, borders, CoreText glyphs, images, and a display list that scrolls without relayout.

paint

What works today

  • Text that wraps, aligns and decorates itself: underlined, struck, bold, small, super and sub.
  • Lists, ordered and not:
    1. alpha markers
    2. counted by the engine
  • Links you can follow: the second page.
  • Forms with text fields, check boxes, radios, selects and buttons.
The DOM is the API. Scripting comes later, on top of the same tree.
Rendered by ui/webview, a package of the Vertex standard library.
